value: Linear visual novel with animated miniguy sequences. Sequel to Magical Mishaps

After the events of the first game(s), all parallel timelines created by different dialogue choices from the previous story have merged into a single world, causing you to become romantically involved with ALL of the girls. In order to resolve this anomaly, a celestial arbiter places you and all other girls in a cohabitation area until she can decide who your true love is.
